issue.body:
`enter_shell()` gated `--integration openlineage` / `--integration all` behind a hardcoded PostgreSQL 12/13/14 check. That list has drifted from Breeze's actual matrix (`ALLOWED_POSTGRES_VERSIONS` is now `13-18`, `CURRENT_POSTGRES_VERSIONS` is `14-18`) — `12` is no longer a valid Breeze Postgres version at all, so in practice the gate only let `openlineage` run against Postgres 14, which is next in line to be dropped from the matrix.

This replaces the hardcoded list with `CURRENT_POSTGRES_VERSIONS` from `global_constants.py`, the same source of truth the rest of Breeze uses for its supported Postgres matrix, so the gate can't silently drift out of sync again.

closes: #69233

## Test plan

- Added `test_enter_shell_openlineage_allows_current_postgres_versions` / `test_enter_shell_openlineage_rejects_stale_postgres_versions` / `test_enter_shell_openlineage_rejects_non_postgres_backend` to `dev/breeze/tests/test_docker_command_utils.py`, covering each currently-supported Postgres version, each version that's allowed for compat but no longer current, and a non-Postgres backend.
- `uv run --project dev/breeze pytest dev/breeze/tests/test_docker_command_utils.py -v` — all 45 tests pass.

issue.body:
* Fix Breeze OpenLineage integration gate stuck on stale Postgres versions

The gate in enter_shell() hardcoded PostgreSQL 12/13/14 as the only
versions allowed with --integration openlineage, but Breeze's actual
matrix has moved to 14-18 (12 isn't even a valid choice anymore).
Derive the allowed set from CURRENT_POSTGRES_VERSIONS in
global_constants.py instead, so the gate can't drift out of sync with
the matrix again.

closes: #69233

* Cover --integration all in OpenLineage Postgres gate tests

Reviewer feedback on apache/airflow#69264: the gate also triggers on
"all" (not just "openlineage"), so the tests should exercise that path
too.
(cherry picked from commit 45df400413e2aa42c3787234888e206006f36e03)
